text: 1. Applicant must be non-Chinese citizen, obey laws of the People’s Republic of China, and abide by rules and disciplines of NCHU after enrolled;2. Applicant of undergraduate program must be senior high school students under the age of 22 with healthy body and excellent character and learning;3. Applicant of master program must be undergraduate students under the age of 30 with healthy body and excellent character and learning.4.Students applying for English-taught majors must be proficient in English listening, speaking, reading and writing, and able to successfully read the textbooks and materials for the major.
